hunks.baseline: The man entered the inn around early afternoon.
hunks.sol: The man entered the inn in the early afternoon.

hunks.baseline: The old wooden door creaked, but no one inside turned to look. Not even the owner and the waiter, who should have been rushing to greet a customer.
hunks.sol: The old wooden door creaked, but no one inside turned to look. Not even the owner or the waiter, who should have rushed to greet a new customer.

hunks.baseline: “So? So what happened?”
hunks.sol: “So? What happened?”

hunks.baseline: Only after the owner filled it to overflowing with bamboo-leaf wine did the old man—the storyteller—go on.
hunks.sol: Only after the owner filled it to overflowing with bamboo-leaf wine did the old man—the storyteller—continue.

hunks.baseline: “A fierce battle broke out. Blood Wolf Sword Lee Cheonbaek brought no fewer than thirty thousand men. Compared to that, the Jin Family of Taiyuan had only three hundred elites.”
hunks.sol: “A fierce battle broke out. Blood Wolf Sword Lee Cheonbaek brought no fewer than thirty thousand men. The Jin Family of Taiyuan, meanwhile, had only three hundred elites.”

hunks.baseline: “Fuck this. This booze tastes like shit. I’m leaving. Hear the rest from the guy who brought up the Nine Sects and One Gang.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck this. This booze tastes like shit. I’m leaving. You can hear the rest from the guy who brought up the Nine Sects and One Gang.”

hunks.baseline: “Now, hold on. Why are you doing this?”
hunks.sol: “Now, hold on. Why are you acting like this?”

hunks.baseline: “Who just said that?”
hunks.sol: “Who said that?”

hunks.baseline: The mood turned ugly, and a young man was shoved back, half-stumbling.
hunks.sol: The mood turned ugly, and a young man was shoved forward, stumbling awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: Only then did the storyteller set his half-raised ass back down. His stomach had turned, and his nerve had thickened to match.
hunks.sol: Only then did the storyteller lower his half-raised ass back onto his seat. His mood had soured, and his nerve had grown to match.

hunks.baseline: Everyone frowned as the storyteller tapped his empty bowl. Now they had to give him money, not more wine. They were in the middle of an unspoken standoff when—
hunks.sol: Everyone frowned as the storyteller tapped his empty bowl. This time he wanted money, not more wine. An unspoken battle of wills broke out among the patrons.
Then—

hunks.baseline: “Well. Whoever that is, they’re a big spender.”
hunks.sol: “Well, now. Whoever threw this sure has deep pockets.”

hunks.baseline: “Why are you looking at me? You trying to get me beaten to death by my wife?”
hunks.sol: “Why are you looking at me? You want my wife to beat me to death?”

hunks.baseline: That was when someone spoke from behind the crowd.
hunks.sol: Someone spoke from behind the crowd.

hunks.baseline: The voice was quiet but resonant. It belonged to the man who had entered the inn earlier. His face was hidden under a bamboo hat pulled low, and the cloak wrapped around him was caked with dust.
hunks.sol: The voice was quiet but resonant. It belonged to the man who had entered the inn earlier. His face was hidden beneath a bamboo hat pulled low, and the cloak covering his body was caked with dust.

hunks.baseline: Nobody needed to say it. Everyone in the inn came to the same conclusion.
hunks.sol: No one needed to say it aloud. Everyone in the inn had reached the same conclusion.

hunks.baseline: In his experience, ruffians and martial artists were only a hair apart. He was an old man who had lived his share of years, but he had no desire to get stabbed to death in a place like this.
hunks.sol: In his experience, there was only a hair’s breadth between a ruffian and a martial artist. The storyteller had lived a long life, but he had no desire to end it with a blade in his gut at a place like this.

hunks.baseline: Fortunately, the man in the bamboo hat was the latter.
hunks.sol: Fortunately, the man in the bamboo hat appeared to be the latter.

hunks.baseline: “Keep it simple. Just the facts.”
hunks.sol: “Keep it brief. Just the facts.”

hunks.baseline: Judging by the voice, he was clearly a young bastard—but a young bastard who had learned martial arts. The storyteller couldn’t treat him carelessly. He rubbed his palms together.
hunks.sol: Judging by his voice, he was obviously a young bastard—but a young bastard who knew martial arts. The storyteller couldn’t afford to treat him carelessly. He rubbed his palms together.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll tell you everything I know, sir. The whole lot.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll tell you everything I know, sir. Every last bit.”

hunks.baseline: “Then Mount Heng Sword Sect… What did you just say?”
hunks.sol: “Then Mount Heng Sword Sect… Wait. What did you just say?”

hunks.baseline: “Shanxi, what?”
hunks.sol: “Shanxi what?”

hunks.baseline: “What? Not at all. The Lesser Family Head is impressive too, but the one who played the biggest role this time was Young Master Jin.”
hunks.sol: “What? Not at all. The Lesser Family Head is impressive too, of course, but the one who played the greatest role this time was Young Master Jin.”

hunks.baseline: “So that Young Master Jin… Wait. Is the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi somehow related to Third Young Master Jin Taekyung?”
hunks.sol: “So this Young Master Jin… Wait. Is the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi somehow connected to Third Young Master Jin Taekyung?”

hunks.baseline: The man, who had been silent until then, snapped his fingers. A second silver tael landed perfectly in the storyteller’s bowl.
hunks.sol: The man fell silent for a moment, then snapped his fingers. A second silver tael landed squarely in the storyteller’s bowl.

hunks.baseline: “I believe I asked you to keep it simple and stick to the facts.”
hunks.sol: “I thought I asked you to keep it brief and stick to the facts.”

hunks.baseline: At the storyteller’s resolute answer, the man sighed.
hunks.sol: The man sighed at the storyteller’s resolute answer.

hunks.baseline: “They’re on the verge of closing their gates. Second Young Master Lee Seogeun had already died, and their Sect Leader, Blood Wolf Sword Lee Cheonbaek, fell in battle. Two days later, even their successor—the First Young Master—was killed fighting a band of mounted bandits.”
hunks.sol: “They’re on the verge of closing their gates. Second Young Master Lee Seogeun was already dead, and their Sect Leader, Blood Wolf Sword Lee Cheonbaek, fell in battle. Two days later, even the heir—the First Young Master—was killed fighting a band of mounted bandits.”

hunks.baseline: “These gutsy bastards heard the Blood Wolf Sword was dead and stormed Mount Heng Sword Sect. Word is they’d been circling nearby from the start, waiting for their chance.”
hunks.sol: “The brazen bastards heard that Blood Wolf Sword was dead and attacked Mount Heng Sword Sect. Word is they’d been lurking nearby from the start, waiting for their chance.”

hunks.baseline: The inn went dead quiet. Everyone expected the big-spending martial artist to drive a third silver tael into the storyteller’s forehead.
hunks.sol: The inn went dead silent. Everyone expected the free-spending martial artist to bury a third silver tael in the storyteller’s forehead.

hunks.baseline: Instead, the man rose from his seat without a word.
hunks.sol: Instead, the man rose without complaint.

hunks.baseline: “I heard you.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for the story.”

hunks.baseline: Even after the man left, the storyteller’s tale went on. They drank without pause, and the snacks never ran out.
hunks.sol: Even after he left, the storyteller’s tale continued. Wine flowed without pause, and the snacks never ran out.

hunks.baseline: They all talked about the struggle for supremacy among martial artists. Victory and defeat. The young hero who had risen like a morning star.
hunks.sol: Everyone joined in, talking about the struggle for supremacy among martial artists. Victory and defeat. The young hero who had risen like a morning star.

hunks.baseline: “It won’t be long before the Jin Family of Taiyuan steps beyond Shanxi and stands tall in the Central Plains. The Lesser Family Head, who excels in both civil and martial arts, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, who rose to prominence this time, and… and who else was it?”
hunks.sol: “It won’t be long before the Jin Family of Taiyuan rises beyond Shanxi and stands tall in the Central Plains. They have the Lesser Family Head, who excels in both civil and martial pursuits, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, who distinguished himself in this battle, and… and who was the other one?”

hunks.sol: “Yeah, but this is top-grade information. I heard it from one of the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s gate guards.”

hunks.baseline: “What’s the fuss?”

hunks.sol: “The Heavenly Axe of the Eighteen Strongholds of Green Forest? That mountain bandit who’s supposed to be a Peak master?”

hunks.baseline: “How would I know? The wilder part is that Yama Whip was there too.”

hunks.baseline: Of all the talk that never stopped, two words came up most often.
hunks.sol: Two names came up more than any others in the endless chatter.

hunks.baseline: The closer the man came to his destination, the more the rumors swelled like a snowball, growing larger and larger.
hunks.sol: The closer the man drew to his destination, the more the rumors snowballed.

hunks.baseline: *The most handsome man of all time. A heaven-bestowed martial physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot stand injustice.*
hunks.sol: *The most handsome man of all time. Blessed by heaven with the perfect martial physique. A chivalrous hero who cannot abide injustice.*

hunks.baseline: The man in the bamboo hat spurred his horse. Even the Shan in Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi was enough to make his stomach churn and his head ache, as if he had taken an internal injury.
hunks.sol: The man in the bamboo hat spurred his horse onward. Hearing so much as the *Shan* in Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi made his stomach churn and his head ache as though he had suffered an internal injury.

hunks.baseline: He finally reached his destination the next morning.
hunks.sol: He finally reached his destination the following morning.

hunks.baseline: *Been a while.*
hunks.sol: *It’s been a while.*

hunks.baseline: The place he had returned to after several years was unchanged.
hunks.sol: The place he had returned to after several years was just as he remembered it.

hunks.baseline: If there was any difference worth mentioning—
hunks.sol: If anything had changed—

hunks.baseline: —it was that a guy who looked like hell was serving as Captain of the Gatekeepers.
hunks.sol: —it was that someone who looked decidedly unwell had become Captain of the Gatekeepers.

hunks.baseline: The water flowed. Calm, and unimpeded.
hunks.sol: The current flowed, calm and unhindered.
